text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a process-based modeling study focused on nitrogen exports and coastal hypoxia linked to river basin management strategies. It does not have a primary focus on land use land cover (LULC) prediction or simulation. Although LULCC (land use and land cover changes) are included as part of the model inputs and historical context, the study does not implement multiple future LULC scenarios with quantitative spatial projections or accuracy metrics. The main emphasis is on nitrogen cycling and its management rather than on spatially explicit LULC future prediction at the national scale. Therefore, it fails the core inclusion criterion of having primary focus on LULC prediction/simulation and outputs mapped LULC projections.)
